sal.basis: Iraqi pay is quoted monthly: in IQD at local firms and state companies, often in USD at oil companies, NGOs and multinationals. Senior Financial Analyst / FP&A, ~8 yrs, Baghdad, at a telecom, private bank, oil-services firm or multinational: about 2.5-4m IQD a month (~USD 1,900-3,000 at the official rate of about 1,300-1,310 IQD per USD); state employers pay less, oil majors and INGOs more (background knowledge, not verified live this run; see sources.md). Chosen 3,000,000 IQD. f = 3,000,000 / 26,000 = 115.38, so Noura's 26,000 becomes ~3.0m IQD now and 34,000 becomes ~3.9m IQD expected.

autoText.en: Iraqi citizens, including dual nationals, can work in Iraq without a work permit.
autoText.ar: يمكن للمواطنين العراقيين، بمن فيهم مزدوجو الجنسية، العمل في العراق دون إجازة عمل.
autoText.fr: Les citoyens irakiens, y compris les binationaux, peuvent travailler en Irak sans permis de travail.

rule.en: If you need a work permit, we focus on international companies, oil and gas operators and NGOs that hire foreign specialists, skip roles open to Iraqis only, and match Kurdistan Region permits to jobs in the Kurdistan Region only.
rule.ar: إذا كنت تحتاج إلى إجازة عمل، نركّز على الشركات الدولية وشركات النفط والغاز والمنظمات التي توظّف خبراء أجانب، ونستبعد الوظائف المخصّصة للعراقيين فقط، ونطابق إجازات إقليم كردستان مع وظائف الإقليم فقط.
rule.fr: Si vous avez besoin d'un permis de travail, nous ciblons les entreprises internationales, les opérateurs pétroliers et gaziers et les ONG qui recrutent des spécialistes étrangers, écartons les offres réservées aux Irakiens et n'associons les permis de la région du Kurdistan qu'aux postes situés dans cette région.

desc.en: Foreign workers need a Ministry of Labour work permit, meant for skills Iraqis can't fill. Licensed investment projects must keep at least half of their workforce Iraqi, and oil-sector contracts require most staff to be Iraqi.
desc.ar: يحتاج العامل الأجنبي إلى إجازة عمل من وزارة العمل، وتُمنح للمهارات غير المتوفرة لدى العراقيين. وتلتزم مشاريع الاستثمار المجازة بألّا تقل نسبة العراقيين بين العاملين فيها عن النصف، وتشترط عقود القطاع النفطي أن يكون معظم الموظفين من العراقيين.
desc.fr: Les travailleurs étrangers ont besoin d'un permis du ministère du Travail, réservé aux compétences introuvables parmi les Irakiens. Les projets d'investissement agréés doivent compter au moins la moitié d'Irakiens dans leurs effectifs, et les contrats du secteur pétrolier imposent une majorité de salariés irakiens.

sensitive.notes: Iraqi CVs follow the regional Arab format: a professional photo and a personal-details block (date of birth, nationality, often marital status) are normal, and forms at state companies, banks and telecoms, as well as Bayt profiles, ask gender, date of birth and nationality. Nationality also drives the work-permit, Kurdistan Region and Iraqi-priority logic. Marital status often appears on CVs but is not needed to apply and is a bias risk, so we do not ask (conservative, same as JO, LY and AE). Labour Law No. 37 of 2015 bans discrimination in employment, so we never filter on gender or age, only on work rights and Iraqi-only postings. Not verified live this run; see IQ.sources.md.

legal.law: No dedicated personal data protection law in force to our knowledge (draft bills only); right to privacy under Article 17 of the 2005 Constitution; Electronic Signature and Electronic Transactions Law No. 78 of 2012; CBI Regulation No. 3 of 2014 on electronic payment services. We apply GDPR-level standards.

privacy.en: Your privacy is protected under Article 17 of Iraq's Constitution. We apply GDPR-level standards and never share your data without your consent.
privacy.ar: خصوصيتك مصونة بموجب المادة 17 من الدستور العراقي، ونطبّق على بياناتك معايير مماثلة للائحة الأوروبية العامة لحماية البيانات (GDPR)، ولا نشاركها دون موافقتك.
privacy.fr: Votre vie privée est protégée par l'article 17 de la Constitution irakienne. Nous appliquons des standards équivalents au RGPD et ne partageons jamais vos données sans votre accord.

renewal.en: Card plans renew automatically at the end of each term at the price shown until you cancel; with ZainCash, you renew by paying again. Cancel anytime in Settings before the renewal date and you won't be charged again.
renewal.ar: تتجدّد الاشتراكات المدفوعة بالبطاقة تلقائياً في نهاية كل فترة بالسعر المعروض إلى أن تلغيها، ومع زين كاش تجدّد اشتراكك بدفعة جديدة. يمكنك الإلغاء في أي وقت من الإعدادات قبل تاريخ التجديد، ولن يُخصم منك أي مبلغ بعد ذلك.
renewal.fr: Les abonnements payés par carte se renouvellent automatiquement à la fin de chaque période, au prix indiqué, jusqu'à résiliation ; avec ZainCash, vous renouvelez en payant à nouveau. Résiliez à tout moment dans les Paramètres avant la date de renouvellement et vous ne serez plus prélevé.

bio.fr: Analyste financier avec 8 ans d'expérience à Bagdad. Je pilote le reporting en IFRS et selon le système comptable unifié irakien ainsi que le budget sous Oracle pour plusieurs business units, et je suis responsable de la clôture mensuelle d'une fonction finance de 25 personnes. Je conçois des tableaux de bord Power BI qui aident la direction à suivre les marges, les coûts et la trésorerie en dinars et en dollars.

culture.notes: Work week Sun-Thu with a Friday-Saturday weekend in government; many private firms also work Saturday (a six-day week is common), and hours shorten in Ramadan. Pay is quoted monthly: IQD at local firms and state companies, USD at oil companies, NGOs and many multinationals; payday is end of month, usually to a salary card (Qi Card at state employers). Finance CVs are in English for multinationals, oil companies and NGOs and in Arabic for local and state employers (Kurdish or English in the Kurdistan Region); usually 2-3 pages, often with a photo and a personal-details block. A cover letter is expected at NGOs and international firms, rarely elsewhere. Labour Law No. 37 of 2015 applies in federal Iraq; the Kurdistan Region still applies Labour Law No. 71 of 1987. One month's notice is the norm for open-ended contracts; senior contracts may set 1-3 months. Arabic is native; English fluency matters on finance applications; Kurdish helps in Erbil and Sulaymaniyah. Foreign hiring needs a work permit and is limited by Iraqi-workforce priority.
